description: $5.00 per day file. Use to backtest or train a rug or graduation model on one full UTC day of pump.fun launches from our capture (about 15k-35k rows); not for live decisions. Rows carry creator, dev buy and share, name/symbol/uri (creator-written text), outcomes by our label rules (graduated with migration delay, rugged with rug delay, creator first-sell delay, peak and terminal reserve) and the first feature snapshots under 10 s and between 10 and 60 s of age. Input: day (UTC YYYY-MM-DD; the days on sale, a 200-row sample and the schema are at the free HTTP index GET /v1/datasets). Returns a one-hour download URL with rows, bytes and sha256. An unknown day is refused before payment and lists the days available.

day.description: UTC day YYYY-MM-DD listed by the free index /v1/datasets

name: buy_dataset
title: Buy one day of pump.fun launches ($5.00)
